neighbours.label: The software menu name that starts a menu path before '>', '->' or '|' ('go to [Tools]->Preferences', '[File] > New', '[Select] > Save Selection', '[Settings] | Options')
fire: If you do not want to change browser, you can head over to Tools->Preferences->Advanced->Network.
When you open a new canvas in Photoshop by going to File > New, a small window pops up.
Then choose Select > Save Selection and give the selection a name you will remember.
This can be found under Tools | Internet Options | Content in the older versions of the browser.
To change the margins, click Settings > Page Setup and set all four values to zero.
In Joomla, open Extensions > Install/Uninstall and upload the package from your disk.
Click Edit > Preferences, then pick the Display tab and turn off the grid.
Go to Help > About to see which version of the program you are running.
quiet: If you do not want to change browser, you can head over to the tools shed in the garden.
When you open a new file in the drawer, a small label shows the name of the owner.
Then choose a good selection of books and give each of them a name tag you will remember.
This can be found under the tools and equipment in the older parts of the museum.
To change the margins, ask the printer for a new setting and set all four values to zero.
In the garden, open the extension of the greenhouse and put the plants on the table.
Click the mouse twice, then pick the second tab and turn off the grid.
Go to the help desk to see which room the program is being held in.

notes: The output direction promotes '>' and '->'. Near misses use the same words in ordinary prose.
